title: PI-09: Operations runbook and a fail-fast startup assertion
summary: No runbook and no startup assertions. Document the config the app assumes but does not control, and assert it right after the DB connects with a deterministic FATAL line whose text is pinned by a test so alerts can match it.

root_cause.details: No operations runbook documenting required environment configuration. No startup assertions to detect misconfiguration early.

resolution_text: Implemented `assertDatabaseConfiguration` in `src/operations/startup_assertions.zig`, wired into `src/main.zig`. Operations runbook at `docs/runbook/OPERATIONS.md`. 5/5 integration tests pass.
prevention_text: Operations runbook documents required env vars. Fail-fast assertion prevents service from starting in misconfigured environments.
